title: Stadium with a long span steel roof, Brisbane: site establishment and traffic
workplace: Stadium with three grandstands, concourses, corporate boxes and a long span steel roof, Brisbane
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Site fencing, hoardings and sheds
swms.task: Erect the site fencing and hoardings along the street frontage, with materials delivered by truck, and set up the site sheds, lifted into place by the crane company's mobile crane.

steps: Work with the crane crew during lifts

swms.title: Traffic management at the site gates
swms.task: Traffic controllers manage trucks, concrete trucks and mobile plant deliveries at the site gates and on the street next to the site, and separate plant and pedestrians on site.

steps: Separate plant and people on site
